summary: Ubuntu 7.10 (Gutsy Gibbon) was released on 18 October 2007. It added AppArmor security framework, fast desktop search, Ubufox Firefox plug-in manager, graphical X.Org configuration, full NTFS read/write via NTFS-3G, revamped printing with PDF by default. Compiz Fusion was enabled by default and fast user switching was added.
notes: Unsupported since 2009-04-18. Kernel 2.6.22. NTFS-3G made dual-boot with Windows much smoother.
